editorial.blurb: Bombay Eats serves authentic Indian street food wrapped in warm roti, built fast and full of flavor right in Chicago.
editorial.insiderTip: Order wraps with mild sauce (3/10 heat) for a balanced kick, or go spicy (7/10) if you like more fire — everything's assembled fresh in front of you and ready in minutes.

topDishes.note: reviewers rave about its delicious balance of fresh fillings and crispy roti
outstanding and authentic, paired well with other menu items
